# Variable `UNINATIVE_URL`

### Yocto Project Reference Manual

When inheriting the uninative class, the UNINATIVE_URL variable contains the URL where the uninative tarballs are published.

Offline source: yocto-manuals/references/manuals/ref-manual/variables.md (online: https://docs.yoctoproject.org/scarthgap/ref-manual/variables.html#term-UNINATIVE_URL)
